brief.claim: In patients attending a hypertension clinic, left ventricular mass adds explanatory power for systolic blood pressure beyond body surface area: the gain in R-squared when left ventricular mass is added to a linear regression of systolic pressure on body surface area is at least 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: Left ventricular mass of each patient from echocardiography, in g.
Body surface area of each patient, in square metres.
Resting systolic blood pressure of each patient, in mmHg.

brief.sizes: patients = 300; lv_mass, body_surface_area and systolic_bp each have shape (300,).
